Ḍalhaṇa
or Ḍallaṇa, son of Bharatapāla (court physician of King Nṛpāladeva); an. court physician of Nṛpāladeva's son Sahadeva; family originally belonged to Aṅkāla village near Mathurā; ref.. to Jajjaṭa, Gayadāsa, Bhāskara (11th Cent.), Mādhava (11th Cent.) an. Brahmadeva in the beg. of his C. on Suśrutasam3hitā; he is in turn mentioned by Hemādri (13th Cent.); hence Ḍalhaṇa is to be assigned to 12th Cent. (Absence of ref. to Cakrapāṇidatta does not show that Ḍ. is earlier).
See Haldar, Vṛddhatrayī, p.. 200-2; also A. R. Hoernle, JRAS. (1906) p. 283 ff.
--C. Nibandhasaṅgraha on Suśrutasam3hitā.
Pt.. Jivananda Vidyasagar, Calcutta, 1891.
